statement.p: Let \lt B>\lt I>u\lt /B>\lt /I> = \left\lt 3,4\right>, \lt B>\lt I>v\lt /B>\lt /I> = \left\lt -3,-2\right>, and \lt B>\lt I>w\lt /B>\lt /I> = \left\lt -4,-3\right>. Find the vector \lt B>\lt I>x\lt /B>\lt /I> that satisfies 9 \lt B>\lt I>u\lt /B>\lt /I> - \lt B>\lt I>v\lt /B>\lt /I> + \lt B>\lt I>x\lt /B>\lt /I> = 4 \lt B>\lt I>x\lt /B>\lt /I> + \lt B>\lt I>w\lt /B>\lt /I>.

solution.p: Solving the given equation for \lt B>\lt I>x\lt /B>\lt /I> yields \begin{array}{lcl} \lt B>\lt I>x\lt /B>\lt /I>\amp =\amp \frac{1}{3}( 9 \lt B>\lt I>u\lt /B>\lt /I> - \lt B>\lt I>v\lt /B>\lt /I> - \lt B>\lt I>w\lt /B>\lt /I>) \\\amp =\amp \frac{1}{3} (9 \left\lt 3,4\right> - \left\lt -3,-2\right> - \left\lt -4,-3\right> ) \\\amp =\amp \frac{1}{3} \left\lt 34,41\right> \\\amp =\amp \left \langle {\frac{34}{3}} ,{\frac{41}{3}} \right\rangle \end{array}
